svg.title: Figure 1. Test set-ups for Lab 6
svg.desc: Three schematic panels. (a) Front view of the 50.8 by 12.7 millimeter aluminum bar held between two steel end blocks; the free length between the blocks is 250 millimeters, and the loading pins sit a distance a beyond each end of the free length. Each block has holes at in-plane offsets of zero, one sixth and one third of the width (x up the bar, y across it); here the pins are in the h/3 holes and the load line runs parallel to the bar, off its centerline. Five gages run across the width at mid-length on each face, and a further pair sits 40 millimeters from one block. (b) Edge view of the same bar with the pins in the fourth hole, offset half the thickness out of plane; a displacement transducer touches the face at mid-length, and a dashed curve shows the bar bowing toward the load line under tension. (c) Section view of the 50.8 by 50.8 by 6.35 millimeter angle, drawn with y up and z to the left: the load acts at a point 28.6 millimeters from the heel along the horizontal leg and 4.76 millimeters below it, in the mid-plane of the gusset that is bolted to the leg at the ends. Gages G1 and G2 are on the outer face of the vertical leg near its tip and near the heel; G3 and G4 are on the underside of the horizontal leg near the heel and near its tip.
